race.comment: TENNESSEE SPIRIT (10) has speed to burn and comes in fresh off 55 days in-between runs. Expect Moore to punch her straight to the front and say catch me if you can. YOLO (3) returns from a spell of four-and-a-half months and it is noteworthy that he has won at his past two first-up appearances, last prep over 1000m at Seymour. Has jumped out sharply in readiness and can make a bright start. BONFIRE JIMMY (6) kicked off the prep with two strong efforts but proved less effective last time despite market support. Blinkers go on and he drops back to the 1000m. Don't dismiss.  PULL MY FINGER (9) only boasts the one win but has placed 11 other times. Consistent type that is sure to be making his presence felt.
